purpose: Generic read-only cognitive health self-check packets for agent context recall. Keep checks project-agnostic; project-specific runtime details belong in governed project data.

checks.question: Do I have authority for this exact framing, or merely the technical ability to edit?
checks.risk_if_failed: Agent may turn diagnosis into implementation or continue after scope drift without renewed approval.

checks.question: What is the canonical source of project state for this work?
checks.risk_if_failed: Agent may rely on chat memory, local files, or direct backend access for governed project state.

checks.question: What is the next safe action from the latest public MCP receipt?
checks.risk_if_failed: Agent may continue from an invented plan instead of the governed workflow state.

checks.question: Do I have an owned task claim and continuation token before mutating task state?
checks.risk_if_failed: Agent may record progress, finish, or mutate task state without ownership proof.

checks.question: Which verification policy applies, and is live/external validation explicitly intended?
checks.risk_if_failed: Agent may confuse formal verification with live diagnostic exploitation.

checks.question: Am I solving this through a general data/spec mechanism rather than one-off code branches?
checks.risk_if_failed: Agent may add narrow special cases instead of improving the general system.
